paper.title_en: General Properties of the Thermo-Metric for CV event manifolds and the magnetization combinatorial scheme
paper.abstract_en: Following previous results recently obtained by us, on Information Geometry versus Geometrical Thermodynamics and on the exact calculation of partition functions for extended Souriau Gibbs distributions on Calabi Vesentini manifolds, we study the differential geometry of the corresponding thermo-metrics. A general intriguing scheme is discovered and put into evidence. A small yet significant difference, distinguishes the even from the odd dimensional instance of the microscopic CV manifolds. Apart from that the complete thermo-space is flat when no constraint is introduced. Freezing the magnetic fields, which can be done according to complicated combinatorials, forces the thermo-system to evolve on curved submanifolds of the thermo--space that have a structure depending only on the length of the $n-1$ chain of frozen contiguous magnetic fields. The behavior of Riemann tensor components for such spaces is codified by a symmetric matrix with peculiar behavior along special symmetrically arranged submanifolds that, might be responsible for the generation of curvature walls and for the categorical partitioning of the thermo space. The embedding of this curved submanifold into $\mathbb{R}^{2n-1}$ can be traced back to the vanishing of magnetic fields and, in this case, the flat metric on $\mathbb{R}^{2n-1}$ is the $\mathfrak{a}_{2n-1}$ simple Lie algebra Cartan matrix. In another version the flat embedding reveals the geometric interpretation of the $n$-manifold as a generalized translation hypersurface. The boundary at infinity has a hypercube structure whose face central points and vertices appear, numerically, to be the end-points of all geodesics depending only on their angular slope at the start. This general feature is reminiscent of the causal structure at infinity of Lorentzian space-times and of Penrose diagrams.

decision.reject_reason_zh: 该论文主题偏离预定义类别，虽然涉及因果结构和Penrose图，但核心是信息几何和热力学流形，与广义相对论基础关联较弱。
decision.title_zh: CV事件流形的热度量的一般性质及磁化组合方案
decision.abstract_zh: 继我们最近在信息几何与几何热力学方面以及关于Calabi Vesentini流形上扩展Souriau Gibbs分布配分函数精确计算的结果之后，我们研究了相应热度量的微分几何。发现并揭示了一个普遍有趣的结构。一个微小但显著的差异区分了微观CV流形的偶数和奇数维实例。除此之外，当没有引入约束时，完整的热空间是平坦的。冻结磁场（可以根据复杂的组合方式进行）迫使热系统在热空间的弯曲子流形上演化，这些子流形的结构仅取决于冻结的相邻磁场链的长度（n-1）。此类空间的黎曼张量分量的行为由一个对称矩阵编码，该矩阵在特殊对称排列的子流形上具有特殊行为，这可能是曲率墙的产生和热空间范畴划分的原因。该弯曲子流形嵌入到ℝ^{2n-1}中可以追溯到磁场的消失，在这种情况下，ℝ^{2n-1}上的平坦度量是𝔞_{2n-1}简单李代数Cartan矩阵。在另一个版本中，平坦嵌入揭示了n流形作为广义平移超曲面的几何解释。无穷远处的边界具有超立方体结构，其面中心点和顶点在数值上似乎是所有测地线的端点，这仅取决于它们起始时的角斜率。这一一般特征让人联想到洛伦兹时空无穷远处的因果结构以及Penrose图。
